The YSL Lash Studio

Pop Up Mob brought YSL Beauty's new Lash Latex Mascara to life with The Lash Studio, a latex-wrapped, high-shine world where strength, stretch, and sculpted beauty moved from campaign to real life.

BeautyFebruary 2026Los Angeles, California100% Experiential
The Story
Los Angeles, CA

Created for the launch of Lash Latex Mascara, The Lash Studio transformed a traditional wellness setting into something bold, controlled, and undeniably YSL. Guests entered a glossy, latex-drenched space where gym cues met glamour, lockers became intimate discovery moments, sleek metal shelving framed the product like equipment for sculpting, and the iconic Cassandre appeared as if pressing through stretched material. At the center, a dramatic latex photo moment invited guests to recreate the campaign's tension and lean, suspended between softness and power, while mirrors, shine, and sharp lighting amplified every angle.
